plan: Given my value of $6, I should bid below this to ensure a positive profit if I win. Since all bidders are rational and aware of each other's rationality, they will likely bid close to their values. To maximize profit, bid slightly below $6, ensuring I pay less than my value if I win. A bid of $5.9 balances winning chances and profit.
